A '''Koyt''' was a [[Species/Legends|creature]] found on the Forest Moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==History==
Koyts residened in the densely [[Forest/Legends|forested]] areas on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. When the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesa]] left [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] with [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] to find her missing sister, [[Asha/Legends|Asha]], Kneesaa's [[Bordok/Legends|Bordok]] was spooked by the cries of band of koyts as [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]] was preparing it to take her back to the village. Despite Wicket's eagerness to help Chukha-Trok fend off the koyts, the larger Chukha-Trok pushed the two woklings away, telling them to hide as he took care of the problem. Wicket was then startled when he saw the Koyts, and he shouted at Chukha-Trok to run from them. Using his axe, Chukha-Trok attacked the koyts, barreling into them and throwing them aside with ease. However, the attacking force was not discouraged, and only the timely intervention of Asha, the lost princess, was able to thwart further battle with the creatures. The koyts were clearly frightened of Asha, as they quickly retreated.<ref name="A" />

==Description==
Koyts hunted in packs. They were incredible fierce and aggressive, as they tried to attack the Ewoks they encountered. They had red fur, long ears and yellow eyes, and they moved around by hopping. Their cries were high-pitched.<ref name="A" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koyts appeared in the ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' episode "[[Asha (episode)|Asha]]".<ref name="A" />
